verdict.rationale:
Yapily separates its offerings into distinct products (Data API for AIS, Payments API for PIS, account confirmation, VRP) each with its own consent screen, implying developers only request the product-specific consent they need rather than a single blanket grant (yapily-docs-2, -15, -16, -20). However, there is no explicit documentation of fine-grained data-minimization controls within a product (e.g., requesting balances only vs. full transaction history) or scope parameters in the API reference.
missing for 10: granular in-product scope/field-level consent documentation, explicit data-minimization API parameters, independent confirmation of scope enforcement.
